title: Praktikum im Financial Consulting (m/w/d)
description: Siehst du deine berufliche Zukunft im Finanzbereich und willst herausfinden, wie echtes Unternehmertum funktioniert? Suchst du nach einem Praktikum, das dir nicht nur theoretisches Wissen, sondern echte Praxisnähe, wertvolle Kontakte und eine überdurchschnittliche Vergütung bietet? Werde Teil unseres Teams in Berlin und lerne von den Besten. Bei HORBACH begleiten wir dich Schritt für Schritt und zeigen dir, wie moderne, kundenorientierte Finanzberatung auf Top-Niveau funktioniert. Seit über 40 Jahren entwickelt HORBACH für Akademikerinnen und Akademiker sowie anspruchsvolle Privatkunden Finanzlösungen nach Maß. Dazu stellen wir die Träume und Pläne unserer Kunden in den Mittelpunkt. Gemeinsam erarbeiten wir einen persönlichen Finanzplan, abgestimmt auf alle Facetten des Lebens. Unsere Mission: Finanzieller Schutz und wirtschaftliche Freiheit für alle Kunden. Ein Leben lang. Unser AngebotZukunftssicherheit & Wachstum: Während viele etablierte Großbranchen in Deutschland aktuell Stellen abbauen, wachsen wir gegen den Trend. HORBACH erreicht seit Jahren kontinuierlich neue All-Time Highs . Bei uns startest du in einem krisenresistenten Zukunftsmarkt mit exzellenten langfristigen Perspektiven. Attraktive Vergütung: Leistungsorientierte Bezahlung ab dem ersten Tag, deine Erfolge im vertrieblichen Umfeld werden bei uns direkt belohnt. Individuelles Mentoring: Ein festes 1-zu-1-Mentoring sowie maßgeschneiderte Coachings, die dich optimal auf kommunikative und vertriebliche Herausforderungen vorbereiten. Starkes Netzwerk: Zugang zu hoch angesehenen Netzwerken und Kontakten, von denen du dein ganzes Berufsleben profitierst. Teamkultur auf Augenhöhe: Ein junges, dynamisches Team in Berlin, das dich unterstützt und fordert. Wir glauben an Heart-work statt hard work! Deine Übernahme-Chance: Das Praktikum ist für uns die ideale Kennenlernphase. Überzeuge uns in den ersten 4 Wochen und sichere dir die direkte Übernahmemöglichkeit als Trainee zum Financial Consultant. Aufgaben Bei uns bist du kein passiver Beobachter, sondern vom ersten Tag an mitten im Geschehen. Wir bieten dir praxisnahe Einblicke in die tägliche Arbeit eines Financial Consultants und binden dich aktiv in das operative Geschäft ein. Du sammelst wertvolle Praxiserfahrung und übernimmst schrittweise Verantwortung in folgenden Bereichen: Terminmanagement: Aktive Unterstützung bei der Vor- und Nachbereitung von Kundenterminen. Neukundengewinnung: Mitwirkung bei vertrieblichen Maßnahmen und der Akquise. Kooperationsaufbau: Unterstützung beim Auf- und Ausbau strategischer Partnerschaften. Kundenanalyse: Analyse und Auswertung von Kundenprofilen als Basis für individuelle Beratungen. Konzeptentwicklung: Erstellung von maßgeschneiderten Finanzkonzepten für unsere Mandanten. Aftersales: Betreuung und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen nach dem Erstkontakt. Qualifikation Dein Profil Du bist im Studium (wirtschaftlicher Schwerpunkt von Vorteil, aber kein Muss) oder befindest dich in einer Orientierungsphase. Du hast ein fundiertes Interesse an Finanzthemen und Freude an der Kommunikation mit Menschen. Erste Vorerfahrungen im kundenorientierten Bereich oder Vertrieb sind hilfreich, aber kein Muss, wir bilden dich umfassend aus. Eine zielstrebige, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und die Motivation, dich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, zeichnen dich aus. Du bist erfolgsorientiert und motiviert, durch sehr gute Leistungen auch überdurchschnittlich zu verdienen. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! title: Trainee Financial Consultant (m/w/d)
description: Sie stehen kurz vor Ihrem (Fach-)Hochschulabschluss oder haben diesen bereits erfolgreich absolviert? Sie interessieren sich für Wirtschafts- und Finanzthemen und suchen nach einem Karrieresprung, bei dem Sie echtes Unternehmertum lernen und gleichzeitig einen gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert stiften können? Werden Sie Teil des Teams und schreiben Sie Ihre eigene Erfolgsgeschichte. Im Rahmen der Trainee-Ausbildung werden Sie Schritt für Schritt auf den Beruf des Financial Consultants vorbereitet. Von der Neukundengewinnung über die Beratung bis hin zur Erstellung individueller Finanzstrategien. Da vertriebliche Aktivitäten ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Ausbildung und Ihrer späteren Tätigkeit sind, ist eine entsprechende Vorerfahrung im Vertrieb zwar hilfreich, stellt jedoch ausdrücklich kein Muss dar. Unser Angebot: Echte Berufserfahrung: Intensives Training on the Job durch ein etabliertes Mentoring-Programm. Anerkannte Qualifikation: Sie absolvieren eine fundierte IHK-Ausbildung gemäß §34d und §34f. Flexibilität: Die Möglichkeit, remote und zeitlich selbstbestimmt zu arbeiten. Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit: Eine Aufgabe, mit der Sie finanzielle Bildung in die Bevölkerung bringen. Entwicklung und Karriere: Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung sowie regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche. Nach dem Trainee-Programm wählen Sie Ihren passenden Karriereweg – entweder im kundenorientierten Spezialistentum oder im führungsorientierten Management. Umfeld und Wissen: Ein dynamisches und teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld sowie wertvolles Finanzwissen, von dem Sie auch persönlich profitieren. Aufgaben Im Rahmen unseres Trainee-Programms durchlaufen Sie die vollständige und praxisnahe Ausbildung zum/zur Financial Consultant. Bei uns erlernen Sie das Handwerk moderner Finanzberatung von Grund auf. Sie übernehmen nach einer fundierten Einarbeitung schrittweise die eigenständige Verantwortung für folgende Aufgabenbereiche: Terminmanagement: Eigenverantwortliche Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung moderner Beratungstermine. Neukundengewinnung: Aktiver Auf- und Ausbau Ihres eigenen Mandantenstamms durch zielgerichtete Vertriebs- und Akquiseaktivitäten. Kundenanalyse: Eigenständige Analyse und Auswertung von Kundenprofilen zur Ermittlung individueller Wünsche und Ziele. Konzeptentwicklung: Erstellung und Präsentation maßgeschneiderter Finanzkonzepte für anspruchsvolle Mandanten. Aftersales & Kundenbetreuung: Langfristige, nachhaltige Betreuung und Begleitung Ihrer Mandanten in allen Lebensphasen. Qualifikation Ihr Profil Ein kurz bevorstehender oder bereits abgeschlossener (Fach-)Hochschulabschluss. Fundiertes Interesse an Finanzthemen und Freude am aktiven Vertrieb. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

 

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

 

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Director of Systems Delivery
description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times , and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab. Functions of the Role As Director of Systems Delivery , you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments. We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory ; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements. Full-Stack System Execution : Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover. Cross-Functional Alignment : Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs. Site Infrastructure Readiness : Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment. Acceptance Testing & Governance : Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols. Service & Operational Handoff : Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime. Process Standardisation : Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. Supply Chain Management : Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines. Commercial Scoping Support : Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability. Experience - Essentials Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times. Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints. Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams. Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models. Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols. Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting. Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement. Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required. Experience - Desirable Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures. Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware. Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals. raw.title: Senior Business Development & Partnerships Manager (m/f/x)
raw.description:
Your Mission

About the role

At ubitricity, we are helping local authorities deliver accessible, reliable and scalable public EV charging infrastructure across the UK.

We are looking for a Senior Business Development & Partnership Manager who is proactive, hands-on and commercially minded. As a sales/ business development role, you will own the sales and tender pipeline by identifying opportunities, turn them into concrete actions and help shape future growth with local authorities, public-sector stakeholders, consultants and strategic partners.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys relationship management with public-sector stakeholders, understands how to approach them professionally and knows how to inform, engage and activate them in the right way. You will play a key role in strengthening existing client relationships, building new client relationships, and developing future opportunities and positioning ubitricity as a trusted long-term partner in the UK EV charging market.

Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local authorities, public-sector clients, consultants and strategic partners.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact across active and future EV charging infrastructure projects.
  • Understand client priorities, local transport plans, procurement timelines and EV charging ambitions.
  • Develop stakeholder engagement plans and account plans for key clients and future opportunities.
  • Prepare, structure and follow up on client meetings, workshops and relationship reviews.
 
Partnership Development & Opportunity Shaping
  • Identify and actively pursue opportunities and collaborations including direct upsells, contract extensions, brownfield opportunities and upcoming tender opportunities.
  • Support early engagement around upcoming EV charging opportunities, including LEVI-funded programmes.
  • Influence future opportunities through strong client relationships, relevant insights and clear positioning of ubitricity’s offer.
  • Maintain relationships with consultants, framework partners, industry stakeholders and public-sector bodies.
  • Represent ubitricity at client meetings, workshops, industry events and relevant stakeholder forums.
 
Sales Pipeline & Commercial Support
  • Own and manage sales and tender pipelines by maintaining visibility of upcoming tenders, opportunity timelines, expected volumes and client decision-making processes.
  • Support the commercial team with pipeline insights, stakeholder intelligence and opportunity development.
  • Contribute to business cases and growth strategies for future network expansion.
  • Produce and present opportunity proposals to Clients to secure future growth.
  • Provide monthly reports to internal stakeholders updating progress against sales and tender pipelines.
 
Contract & Relationship Performance
  • Support client reviews in conjunction with Network Performance Manage focusing on relationship quality, utilisation, availability and future growth.
  • Identify relationship risks early and help coordinate internal actions to address them.
  • Work with commercial, delivery and operations teams to improve client experience.
  • Support initiatives that improve existing contracts, including utilisation, signage, dedicated bays and local engagement.


Your profile

What You Bring

  • Experience in client relationship management, key account management, partnership management, business development or stakeholder engagement.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with public-sector organisations, local authorities or complex institutional clients.
  • Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Commercial mindset with the ability to spot opportunities and turn them into action.
  • Confidence in approaching, informing and engaging public-sector stakeholders in a professional and effective way.
  • Structured approach to account planning, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation and follow-up.
  • Hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented working style.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across commercial, delivery, operations, marketing and leadership teams.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
 Desirable
  • Experience in EV charging, energy, transport, infrastructure, mobility or public-sector markets.
  • Understanding of UK local authorities, public-sector procurement or infrastructure funding programmes.
  • Solid Client network around street lighting and EV Local Authorities Managers and decision makers.
  • Knowledge of the UK EV charging market and LEVI funding initiatives.
  • Experience supporting early market engagement, tender positioning or strategic account development.


Our Offer

This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in the E-Mobility transition by scaling a well-established and uniquely placed business in the sector. ubitricity offer the opportunity to work in an agile, forward-thinking start-up backed by leading global energy and automotive companies.

Benefits of working at ubitricity  

  • 25 holiday days (plus public holidays) 
  • Hybrid Working (min. 2 days in the office NW5)
  • Opportunities for trips to Berlin head office  
  • A choice of: Healthcare Insurance with Comprehensive level of cover, Employer Pension Monthly top up
  • Free coffee and healthy snacks in office 
  • Social company events
Statement on diversity 
We take pride in being a diverse organisation with a strong diversity and inclusion culture. We believe that everyone is different, and that difference brings value. Inclusion and inclusive behaviours are at the heart of effective collaboration, be it with team members, colleagues in other parts of our company, or with our customers. Every voice is heard.


Your application

We also learn more every day and grow with our challenges, so don't be afraid to apply if you don't have some knowledge yet. We look forward to receiving your application with details of when you can start and your salary expectations.

title: Content Writer (B2B SaaS, Remote - EU/UK)
description: SaaStorm is a fully remote organic growth agency for B2B SaaS, headquartered in London with a team spread across Europe. Since founding in 2024, we've grown to work with SaaS companies from pre-seed through Series C, and we're approaching €1.5M ARR. What makes us different is the bet we've made: search is changing, and the companies that win the next five years will be the ones cited by LLMs, not just ranked by Google. We've built our delivery model around that thesis, combining traditional organic growth with AEO/LLM visibility work, and we report on pipeline impact rather than vanity metrics. In this role, you’ll be responsible for producing high-quality content that supports our SEO and content strategy - helping drive measurable outcomes such as sign-ups, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, and long-term brand value for both SaaStorm and our B2B SaaS clients. You’ll work closely with our strategists and delivery team to turn briefs, research, and positioning into clear, compelling, conversion-aware content that meets quality standards and deadlines. description: Your mission Welcome to your new opportunity with Sungrow! As an EV Field Service Engineer , you will play a crucial role in supporting our customers and ensuring the reliable operation of Sungrow EV charging solutions across the UK. You will be a trusted technical partner, delivering remote and on-site support while helping customers get the most from our products. This is an exciting opportunity to become one of our early EV engineering specialists in the UK. You will have significant scope for career growth, including the potential to help build and lead a local EV engineering team in the future. Please note that this role involves up to 60% travel , with approximately three days per week spent on customer sites. Your ResponsibilitiesCustomer Service Device Monitoring & Remote Diagnostics Proactively monitor commissioned EV chargers remotely to identify potential issues. Diagnose and resolve charger malfunctions, communication issues, and electrical, electronic, or control-system faults. Troubleshoot communication with local inverters, energy meters, onboard controllers, and customer SCADA systems. Clearly explain issues and resolutions to customers, building confidence in Sungrow products. Implement proactive actions—including remote reboots, configuration changes, and firmware updates—to maximise fleet availability and minimise downtime. Commissioning & Field Troubleshooting Align commissioning activities for new EV chargers with customer requirements. Provide clear remote guidance and support for commissioning tasks. Plan and coordinate on-site commissioning with installers, electricians, platform technicians, and other stakeholders. Integrate EV chargers into customer systems, including local grids, EMS controllers, OCPP backends, and shared-meter arrangements. Configure systems to ensure safe, reliable, and seamless operation. Lead on-site troubleshooting for complex technical issues and replace faulty components in compliance with electrical safety regulations. Specialised Tool Expertise Develop strong expertise in Sungrow monitoring and diagnostic tools. Use these tools to identify potential issues early and support proactive maintenance. Product Improvement & Data Management Quality Issue Reporting Identify and document recurring quality issues for Product, R&D, and Manufacturing teams. Contribute practical field insights that support continuous product improvement. Database Management Maintain accurate customer, service, and issue records in internal systems. Data Processing Enhancement Support improvements to internal data-processing methods and platforms to strengthen performance evaluation and fault detection. Your mission

Welcome to your new opportunity with Sungrow!

As an EV Field Service Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our customers and ensuring the reliable operation of Sungrow EV charging solutions across the UK. You will be a trusted technical partner, delivering remote and on-site support while helping customers get the most from our products.

This is an exciting opportunity to become one of our early EV engineering specialists in the UK. You will have significant scope for career growth, including the potential to help build and lead a local EV engineering team in the future.

Please note that this role involves up to 60% travel, with approximately three days per week spent on customer sites.

Your ResponsibilitiesCustomer Service

Device Monitoring & Remote Diagnostics

  • Proactively monitor commissioned EV chargers remotely to identify potential issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve charger malfunctions, communication issues, and electrical, electronic, or control-system faults.

We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About the Role The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced Engagement Manager to own Legora's global relationship with one of the Big 4, one of our most significant partnerships, and to fundamentally change the way that firm works with Legora. This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of this client globally: building the relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how their teams operate. Global means global. You will set the strategy for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide,and Engagement Managers in other regions will run their local programmes against the direction and decisions you set. Day to day, you will be the point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice from our London office, and you will travel regularly to other member firms in the network to build those relationships and land the programme on the ground. Expect to be travelling around 25% of the time. At the heart of the role is designing the client's adoption playbook and delivering a multi-year change-management programme that transforms how they work. You will build the roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption,define measurable outcomes and ROI and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping the client realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. What You'll Do You'll own the global relationship end to end, leading the post-sale experience across every member firm we work with. Specifically, you will: ● Set the global adoption strategy for the account and lead its execution across regions. Engagement Managers in other markets will deliver their local programmes against the strategy and decisions you set, and you will be accountable for coherence and outcomes globally. ● Act as the primary point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice, while travelling frequently to other member firms to build senior relationships and support local delivery in person. ● Design the client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map and target outcomes for how the firm adopts Legora and transforms the way it works. ● Execute against that playbook, sequencing initiatives from initial rollout to enterprise-wide scaled adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve. ● Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands the client's goals and legal and professional services workflows, surfaces high-impact opportunities and guides teams towards maximum value from Legora. ● Drive sustained value through a structured operating cadence: success plans, enablement, stakeholder check-ins, training and value reviews. ● Orchestrate engagement from cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), maintaining end-to-end account context and coordination globally. ● Partner with GTM on key commercial moments to ensure seamless transitions, continuity and exceptional customer experience, and to identify and realise expansion opportunities across the account. ● Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning and enablement. What You Bring You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed. We're looking for: ● 5 – 8 years' experience in management consulting, legal, LegalTech or customer success in an AI-native B2B vertical. ● Extensive experience working with or inside a Big 4 firm is highly desirable, we want someone who already understands how these firms are structured, how decisions get made and how change actually lands across member firms. ● A consulting or transformation background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, complex organisations. ● Experience building tailored transformation roadmaps and adoption plans and steering them to measurable outcomes. ● A track record of driving adoption, retention and satisfaction with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders. ● Experience leading through influence rather than direct authority. You will set the direction that colleagues in other regions deliver against, so you need to be able to bring people with you. ● Experience working with legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast. ● Strong programme and project management skills; you keep multi- work stream initiatives moving and your clients confident. ● Excellent communication skills — written, verbal and interpersonal. You can lead boardroom conversations with legal and professional services leaders and roll up your sleeves with hands-on teams. ● High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act. ● A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it. ● Fluency with metrics and driven by data, customer health and outcomes over process. ● Willingness to travel internationally around 25% of the time. raw.title: Engineering Manager
raw.description:
About Stora

Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.

Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.

In just over five years, Stora has grown from an early-stage product into a platform used by more than 500 operators.

We’re a product-led, remote-first company with an experienced engineering team and ambitious plans for what comes next.

Now, as the engineering organisation grows, we’re hiring an Engineering Manager to make sure the way we lead, develop and support engineers grows with it.

The Role

This is a genuine people leadership role.

You’ll manage approximately 12 engineers working across three product teams, with the team expected to continue growing.

Each product team has a Tech Lead responsible for technical direction, alongside Product and Design. Your focus is different: the engineers themselves.

This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora.

What Else You’ll Own

Engineering Management

  • Manage engineers across multiple product teams through regular, useful 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback.

  • Make expectations clear and help engineers understand what good performance looks like.

  • Identify performance issues early and handle difficult conversations properly when needed.

  • Support engineers in progressing from junior through senior and beyond.

  • Build strong relationships with engineers without creating unnecessary management overhead.

Performance & Progression

  • Own the engineering performance and progression approach.

  • Review and improve our existing career levels, expectations and review processes.

  • Make promotion and progression decisions that are consistent, evidence-based and understood by the team.

  • Create a culture where feedback happens throughout the year rather than being saved for formal reviews.

Hiring & Team Development

  • Own engineering hiring alongside the relevant Tech Leads and wider team.

  • Help define what we need before a search begins, assess candidates properly and maintain a high hiring bar.

  • Ensure new engineers have a structured and useful onboarding experience.

  • Think proactively about team composition, capability gaps and future hiring needs.

Team Health

  • Pay attention to engagement, retention, collaboration and emerging people issues across the engineering organisation.

  • Work with Tech Leads when team problems sit somewhere between technical delivery, behaviour and team dynamics.

  • Help maintain a strong remote engineering culture as Stora grows.

Technical Context

  • Stay close enough to the engineering work to understand what the team is solving and the environment they’re working within.

  • Be comfortable reading code, following pull requests and participating intelligently in technical conversations.

  • Partner with Tech Leads without competing with them for technical ownership.

What Success Looks Like

After your first year, we’d expect:

  • Engineers to have a clear understanding of what is expected of them and how they can progress.

  • Managers and engineers to be having better, more useful conversations about performance and development.

  • Performance issues to be addressed early rather than becoming surprises.

  • A progression framework that works for the engineering organisation Stora has become, not the company we were several years ago.

  • Stronger and more consistent hiring and onboarding.

  • The Head of Engineering spending less time acting as the default people manager for the entire engineering organisation.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager, rather than somebody taking their first step into management.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Previous experience directly managing software engineers across more than one team or product area.

  • A strong track record of developing engineers at different stages of their careers.

  • Hands-on experience managing performance, including difficult or underperformance situations.

  • Experience making promotion and progression decisions.

  • Experience running or improving engineering career frameworks, review cycles or progression processes.

  • Previous experience hiring software engineers and building effective interview processes.

  • An engineering background that allows you to understand code and contribute meaningfully to technical conversations.

  • The judgement to know when to get involved and when to leave technical decisions with the Tech Leads.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in a remote environment.

  • A practical understanding of how AI tools are changing software engineering and experience using them in your own work.

Experience with Ruby or Rails would be useful, but it isn’t essential.

We’re much more interested in whether you can lead engineers well.

What This Role Isn’t

It’s worth being clear that this isn’t:

  • a Tech Lead role with some people management added on;

  • a delivery or project management position;

  • a Product Manager role;

  • a hands-on engineering role where you’ll spend most of your week writing production code;

  • a first Engineering Manager opportunity.

Technical leadership already exists within the product teams.

We’re hiring you because engineering management itself deserves dedicated ownership.

Our Technology

You won’t be expected to spend most of your time writing production code, but you should be comfortable working around our stack.

Backend: Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, TimescaleDB

Frontend: Turbo, React, ViewComponents, Sass

Testing: Minitest, Playwright

Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku

Salary & Benefits

  • Salary: Highly competitive and depending on experience

  • Location: Fully remote within the UK or Ireland

  • Belfast office: Available for anyone who wants to use it

  • Private health insurance for you and your family

  • Company pension

  • 35 days’ annual leave inclusive of applicable public/statutory holidays, depending on location

  • Learning and development support

  • Share options

  • Work-from-home budget

Our Hiring Process

We’re reviewing applications as they arrive rather than waiting for a closing date.

If your experience looks like a strong match, we’ll explain the process clearly from the outset and move quickly.

Equal Opportunities at Stora

Stora is an equal opportunities employer.c

We want to build a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect, and where different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are valued.

We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment and employment decisions are based on merit, competence and business need, and we promote equality of opportunity and fair participation in line with our responsibilities under Northern Ireland equality legislation.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Learning & Development Specialist
description: About us Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator. The role We're hiring a Learning & Development Specialist in London to design and deliver how Encord teaches the specialist workforce behind its human data — the annotators producing work for frontier AI labs and physical AI companies, in domains such as medical imaging and robotics, and on data types we are running for the first time. How well that workforce is taught is the largest controllable driver of the quality we ship. You will work at the point where a technical specification becomes something a non-specialist can execute correctly: converting dense, sometimes ambiguous annotation guidelines into instruction a distributed workforce absorbs in days rather than weeks, and into assessment that proves they have. That teaching problem is a real one, and it is why we are hiring for learning-science expertise rather than for training delivery. The people you teach are capable adults, but they are not domain experts, they come from a wide range of educational backgrounds, and they are frequently working in their second language. Managing cognitive load, breaking a specification into modules that build on each other, leading with worked examples before independent practice, and testing for what actually predicts performance on the job — that craft is the role. It is a hands-on role. You will design the material and you will stand up and teach it, and it is measured in operational terms: ramp time to competence, first-pass quality, and how much of the workforce is qualified for the work we are selling. What you'll do Turn a client specification and a set of annotation guidelines into teachable material within days of a project launch — modular, sequenced, and built on worked examples, edge-case libraries and annotated failure cases Design against explicit learning-science principles rather than instinct — manage intrinsic and extraneous cognitive load, chunk a dense specification into modules that build, scaffold then fade support, and use spaced retrieval so what is taught in week one survives to week four Run live training sessions yourself, remotely and to distributed cohorts, daily during a project ramp — and adjust in the room when a concept is not landing Build criterion-referenced assessments that decide readiness rather than test recall, with pass thresholds set alongside the Quality Systems Lead — so that nobody works a project queue without having demonstrated they meet the standard Design for a novice audience by default: no assumed prior knowledge, plain language, and material that works for someone reading in their second language Build durable curricula for the domains we sell repeatedly — medical imaging, document AI, LLM evaluation and red-teaming, robot teleoperation, egocentric capture — with progression into higher-skill, higher-rate work Coach the Human Data Program Managers into better teachers: session formats, feedback technique, and observation against a standard, since much of the instruction is delivered by them rather than by you Sit with annotators and watch where they get stuck, then redesign — most of what you need to know is visible in the first hour someone spends on a new task Partner with Product on what belongs inside the Encord platform as guidance at the point of work rather than in a course nobody re-opens Measure every programme against a before-and-after in quality and throughput terms, and retire the ones that do not move an operational number Who we're looking for Grounded in raw.description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're hiring a Learning & Development Specialist in London to design and deliver how Encord teaches the specialist workforce behind its human data — the annotators producing work for frontier AI labs and physical AI companies, in domains such as medical imaging and robotics, and on data types we are running for the first time. How well that workforce is taught is the largest controllable driver of the quality we ship.

You will work at the point where a technical specification becomes something a non-specialist can execute correctly: converting dense, sometimes ambiguous annotation guidelines into instruction a distributed workforce absorbs in days rather than weeks, and into assessment that proves they have.

That teaching problem is a real one, and it is why we are hiring for learning-science expertise rather than for training delivery. The people you teach are capable adults, but they are not domain experts, they come from a wide range of educational backgrounds, and they are frequently working in their second language. Managing cognitive load, breaking a specification into modules that build on each other, leading with worked examples before independent practice, and testing for what actually predicts performance on the job — that craft is the role.

It is a hands-on role. You will design the material and you will stand up and teach it, and it is measured in operational terms: ramp time to competence, first-pass quality, and how much of the workforce is qualified for the work we are selling.


What you'll do

  • Turn a client specification and a set of annotation guidelines into teachable material within days of a project launch — modular, sequenced, and built on worked examples, edge-case libraries and annotated failure cases

  • Design against explicit learning-science principles rather than instinct — manage intrinsic and extraneous cognitive load, chunk a dense specification into modules that build, scaffold then fade support, and use spaced retrieval so what is taught in week one survives to week four

  • Run live training sessions yourself, remotely and to distributed cohorts, daily during a project ramp — and adjust in the room when a concept is not landing

  • Build criterion-referenced assessments that decide readiness rather than test recall, with pass thresholds set alongside the Quality Systems Lead — so that nobody works a project queue without having demonstrated they meet the standard

  • Design for a novice audience by default: no assumed prior knowledge, plain language, and material that works for someone reading in their second language

  • Build durable curricula for the domains we sell repeatedly — medical imaging, document AI, LLM evaluation and red-teaming, robot teleoperation, egocentric capture — with progression into higher-skill, higher-rate work

  • Coach the Human Data Program Managers into better teachers: session formats, feedback technique, and observation against a standard, since much of the instruction is delivered by them rather than by you

  • Sit with annotators and watch where they get stuck, then redesign — most of what you need to know is visible in the first hour someone spends on a new task

  • Partner with Product on what belongs inside the Encord platform as guidance at the point of work rather than in a course nobody re-opens

  • Measure every programme against a before-and-after in quality and throughput terms, and retire the ones that do not move an operational number

 

Who we're looking for

  • Grounded in learning theory, and able to say which principle you are applying and why — cognitive load, the worked-example effect, scaffolding and fading, spaced and retrieval practice, criterion-referenced assessment

  • You teach as well as design. You will be in front of a cohort regularly and you are good at it, including when the room is not following you

  • You design for the learner in front of you rather than for someone like yourself — assumed prior knowledge is the most common way training fails here

  • Execution-oriented: a project launching next week needs material this week, and competence in days rather than a term

  • Analytically rigorous. You read quality data and can tell which failures are teachable and which are not, and you are happy being measured on operational metrics rather than completion rates and satisfaction scores

  • You work from a technical specification, and you are often the person who notices the guidelines contradict themselves

  • A clear writer and a strong cross-functional communicator. Most of the workforce you are teaching you will never meet in person

  • Entrepreneurial: this is the first dedicated learning hire here, and you will invent the system rather than inherit one

 

Experience requirements

  • A formal grounding in education, learning science or instructional design — a degree, postgraduate qualification, teaching qualification or equivalent professional training. This is a requirement for this role rather than a preference

  • 3–6 years of professional experience designing and delivering training in an operational environment —where training was measured against production outcomes

  • Demonstrable live facilitation to adult learners, remotely and at cohort scale, not only one-to-one coaching

  • You have built curriculum and assessment from scratch, including assessments that genuinely discriminate between competent and not

  • Experience teaching non-specialist adults, ideally across languages, geographies and levels of prior education

  • Multi-format authoring: written documentation, video, and interactive assessment

  • Comfortable working in data: enough fluency to evaluate your own programmes against quality and throughput reporting

  • Bonus: a classroom or vocational teaching background, or a language-teaching qualification such as CELTA or equivalent

  • Bonus: experience working with teams in India or comparable delivery geographies

  • Bonus: familiarity with annotation, evaluation or model-training workflows

 

Why Encord

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget
